In this section, metrics for CDL and TDL models are plotted. Here, the final truncated 12-cluster model rCDL-C1 is referred to as A4, and its untruncated 24-cluster version is referred to as A2. Figure 6.4.4-1 depicts the SDPD of CDL-C A2 and A4. As can be seen, the TX side is much more spatially selective than the RX side. The difference between models A2 and A4 is very small. The theoretical and measured curves match very well at TX side, while at RX side some difference remains. Figure 6.4.4-2 shows the absolute value of FC for CDL-C A2 and A4. As can be seen, the frequency coherence properties of the 24-cluster A2 and the 12-cluster A4 models are somewhat different. This is mainly due to the post-truncation delay scaling.
